subtitle: Out Manila · Fly + cruise
overview: Fly via Guangzhou to Yichang, then board the luxury Vista Aurora for a 4-night cruise through the Three Gorges, with shore excursions along the way. Disembark in Chongqing for a city tour and a 5-star hotel stay before flying home. Cruise accommodation is a Deck 2 balcony cabin, with 2 nights in 5-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 21–27 2026 to Dec 21–27 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Sanyou Cave: A scenic limestone cave and gorge area near Yichang, visited on the way to the cruise.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Cruise Center: The cruise terminal at Yichang where guests board the complimentary sightseeing cruise.
placeDesc.Xiling Gorge: The easternmost of the Three Gorges, passed in two sections on the cruise.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Ship Lift: A giant lift at the Three Gorges Dam that raises and lowers ships between river levels.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Dam: A huge hydroelectric dam on the Yangtze River, visited at the Dam Closure Memorial Park.
placeDesc.Wu Gorge: The middle of the Three Gorges, known for its forested peaks, passed by cruise.
placeDesc.Wushan: A town on the Yangtze where the tour takes an evening sightseeing boat to see the Three Gorges Light show.
placeDesc.Qutang Gorge: The shortest and narrowest of the Three Gorges, passed by cruise on Day 4.
placeDesc.Baidi City: A hilltop temple town at the mouth of Qutang Gorge, linked to poetry and history of the Three Gorges.
placeDesc.Baiheliang Underwater Museum: A museum built around an ancient stone ridge on the Yangtze riverbed, used to record river levels.
placeDesc.Project 816 Site: A former underground military factory near Chongqing, now open as a visitor site.
placeDesc.People’s Square: A central city square in Chongqing, a stop on the city tour.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing metro station where the light rail runs through a residential building, a popular photo spot.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping district of Chongqing, with the Liberation Monument at its centre.
placeDesc.Hongyadong: A stilted riverside complex in Chongqing that lights up at night, visited on the city tour.
